== Summary ==
[[Jan Westergard]] with the first-place trophy after winning the [[2008 US East Nationals]] at Origins, Greater Columbus Convention Center, Columbus, Ohio. Behind him is the Players Committee "Come back to the game you love" banner.

* '''Source:''' [https://www.flickr.com/photos/28182354@N06/2628353558/ "winner shot 1"], flickr, posted by brad227lex on 1 July 2008. flickr caption: "2008 east nationals champ jan westergard". The Players Committee embedded this photo in its news post [https://web.archive.org/web/20080803131916/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=88 2008 East Nationals Champ - Jan Westergard] (1 July 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 3 August 2008.
* '''Original image:''' https://live.staticflickr.com/3128/2628353558_6261dc3edf_o.jpg (3264×2448, Kodak EasyShare M883)
* '''Date:''' 28 June 2008 (camera time 21:05)
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brad Eier]] (flickr user ''brad227lex''), chairperson of the [[2008 US East Nationals]]. The account is his: its bye-card photo is captioned "this is the card i got at yavin" and the card bears the handwritten name Brad Eier (see [[:File:2008 Worlds Day 2 bye card Yavin IV Regional Brad Eier.jpg]]), and the sealed-deck caption says "we ran" the side event.
* '''Licence:''' flickr lists the photo as All Rights Reserved. Uploaded as a record of the tournament with the wiki owner's approval; credit the photographer and link the flickr page when reusing.
* '''Identification:''' flickr caption names him; the same photo (500 px) illustrates the Players Committee news post that announced his win.
